description: Summarise an OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0 API from a URL (SSRF-safe) or an inline JSON / YAML spec, so an agent can learn an API fast: title, version, servers / base URLs, auth schemes (API key, bearer, OAuth flows), and every operation with method, path, operationId, summary, tags, parameters (with $ref resolved), request body types, response codes and per-operation security. Filter by tag or search text. Price: $0.004 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/openapi-summary

search.description: Only operations whose path, operationId or summary contains this text

spec.description: Inline spec as a JSON object, or a JSON / YAML string (instead of url)

url.description: URL of the spec (JSON or YAML)

name: openapi_summary
title: Openapi Summary
